Formulation
- The presentation is dominated by episodic focal neurological symptoms (numbness/weakness) with gait disturbance and fatigue, raising concern for TI A/ministroke versus other neurological etiologies. Family history of stroke and current self-initiated aspirin use are relevant risk factors. No mental health symptoms or psychiatric risk identified in the transcript. An urgent neurologic evaluation via a TIA clinic is planned; monitoring instructions and emergency guidance provided for potential deterioration.
